findings.line: the converter commit sentence (and manifest evidence_inputs converter_git_commit_in_receipts)
findings.text: The fragment states 'The converter's git commit recorded in each receipt is b466d2f33f2e09813ddf5992963ff52638f52011', and the manifest's evidence_inputs repeats converter_git_commit_in_receipts as b466d2f3. Both receipts on disk record a different commit. Independent readback: OP1/receipt.json and OP2/receipt.json each carry converter = {'module': 'imas_ambix/data/selene_deck.py', 'git_commit': '6ea7df62b4c3d7c715d87bc5308c42a054557529'} -- a search for b466d2f3 counts 0 lines in each receipt and a search for 6ea7df62 counts 1 line in each. The mechanism is converter_git_commit() at imas_ambix/data/selene_deck.py:86, which runs `rev-parse HEAD` in the module's directory, i.e. the HEAD of the tree the converter is imported from at run time; this reviewer confirmed that by driving the same module from the review worktree, whose receipts recorded b829653caa3ff29b03397566a94656c2ae85ffa6. The receipts therefore record the run's own tree HEAD (the fragment commit 6ea7df62), not the base b466d2f3 the fragment names, and neither is the commit that last changed selene_deck.py (31f57375ff8bbb611c1b86d74579d125e4854659). A reader following the fragment's provenance pointer is sent to a commit the artifact does not carry. No artifact value is affected, since the converter module is byte-identical across b466d2f3 and 6ea7df62 (the fragment commit touches only the HTML); the defect is confined to the provenance claim.

Plan section 4 states the run's measure as: 'its receipts name the facility path and hash of each source'. The delivered receipts name the landed copy path (/work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/machine_description/source/<file>) and its sha256, not the facility path; the facility origin lives only in source/provenance.json, joined by sha256. The follow-on is recorded by the run itself and is a converter behaviour (selene_deck.py records the path it read), outside this node's no-code-change measure. The hash half of the clause is met and independently verified against two separate investigation inventories.

follow_ons: Embed the facility path (not only the local landed-copy path) in each receipt, or have the run write it, so the plan section 4 receipt clause is met without a provenance.json join. This is a converter change.
Correct the fragment's converter-commit sentence and the manifest's converter_git_commit_in_receipts: the receipts record 6ea7df62 (the run's tree HEAD), not b466d2f3.
tf/coils_n and tf/coil[:]/turns remain unset with a recorded validation gap, because neither deck states a TF coil or turn count; a value would need a source not in these decks.
The tf COCOS field and the probe unknown-unvalidated label (carried from the converter review) are not in scope of this run's measure and remain open for the description-bindings node.

justifications: Independent review of run r-20261005T093737816746-jtmm-description-convert-run, base b466d2f3, head 6ea7df62, plan imas-ambix:jt60sa-machine-map section 4, stored as a parsed record scoring all five dimensions in 0..20 -- goal_fidelity 17, evidence 17, scope_discipline 20, durability 18, fit 19 -- total 91, added_failure_count 0 with added_failure_ids [] (the reviewed run is unarmed and changes no code, so there is no suite delta; basis in added_failures_basis). Verification was by three independent routes, none of them a re-read of the run's own summary. (1) Provenance: recomputed sha256 of the three landed source copies and found each equal to the investigation inventories (jtmm-analysis-sensor-search/inventory.json for EQSLE.DATA and geo.in, jtmm-geometry-source/inventory.json for coil_vv_OP2.dat) and to the source copies in the report directories -- all three triples agree. (2) Content: drove the reviewed worktree's own imas_ambix.data.selene_deck into a scratch tree from the intact facility copies; the ten emitted ids netCDF files are byte-identical to the delivered ones, and every headline count (12 coils 40,40,40,40,16x6,6,6; OP1 63@7.76e-7 + 57@7.20e-7; OP2 98@7.20e-7; 17 probes; 27 loops; wall 638/51; tf 7+7) matches. (3) Guard: reproduced the declared negative control by appending one byte to an EQSLE.DATA copy and driving the run's own driver with CONVERT_SRC_OVERRIDE -- refused on sha256 mismatch with the identical mutated hash 84daa250 and EXIT=1 before any write, artifacts on GPFS untouched (mtime unchanged). Two defects recorded against the delivery: the evidence fragment (and manifest) state the receipts record converter commit b466d2f3, while both receipts record 6ea7df62 -- the run's own tree HEAD, proven by the mechanism (selene_deck.py:86 rev-parse HEAD) and by the reviewer's own scratch receipts recording the review worktree's HEAD b829653c; and the receipts name the landed copy path, not the facility path the plan section 4 measure asks for (already disclosed as a follow-on). Neither affects an artifact value, since the converter module is unchanged across the heads involved. Reviewed worktree clean at 6ea7df62; one commit, one file, inside the declared write set.
